data.title: Android Software Engineer - AI Neobank App
data.description:
About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role We are looking for Android software engineers to build the native Android experience for Doit's AI Neobank App. This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers. What You'll Own - Build and ship Android features using Kotlin. - Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services. - Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys. - Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable. - Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage. - Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product. - Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey. What We're Looking For - 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin. - Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps. - Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture. - Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows. - Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues. - Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality. - App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage. Tech Stack - Kotlin - Jetpack Compose - Android SDK - Coroutines & Flow - SQL / NoSQL - TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference) The Kind of Builder We Want - Thinks in user journeys, not just screens. - Cares about making complex financial products feel simple. - Moves fast without creating messy code. - Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain. - Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim. This Role Is Not For - Engineers who only want fully defined tickets. - Developers who build screens without caring about user experience. - People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance. - Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment. - People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/android-software-engineer-ai-neobank-app-bjak-1790748064684

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Immuware) - Remote, US
data.description:
Propelus® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare. Our innovative technology and strategic partnerships empower millions of professionals, their employers, and regulators to work together, creating a connected and efficient healthcare ecosystem. As a trusted leader for over 20 years, Propelus has focused on bringing more good into the lives of the people and organizations serving healthcare. We deliver seamless compliance solutions to millions. We leverage market-leading technology and essential data to simplify complex operations, reduce risk, and champion a safer, healthier, and happier workforce. About the Role: Immuware's customers, including Employee Health nurses; occupational health managers; and compliance professionals, work in one of the most requirement-heavy environments in healthcare IT. Regulations shift. Organizational structures change. New workflows emerge. Each of these changes often means hands-on work is needed inside their Immuware environment. The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) exists to meet that need. You are both technically driven and a proactive, friendly, and compelling person. You will be embedded in the post-sales customer experience, you are not an account management, not executing billable project work, and not break-fix support. You show up on customer calls, quickly understand the technical needs of a health-system nurse manager and what they are trying to accomplish, and provide the polished product quickly, ensuring a positive experience. What You'll Do: As our Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will be the proactive technical resolution of customer problems end to end: From meticulously understanding the clients needs and proactively building those solutions, you ultimately serve as the bridge between customer needs and internal product and engineering teams. You're measured on customer outcomes, not on activity. This role partners closely with our Customer Success Managers, who own the overall customer relationship, strategy, and commercial outcomes. Technical Solutioning & Building - Lead regular (often weekly) technical working sessions with customers to address actively evolving needs driven by regulatory changes, organizational shifts, and workflow updates. - Identify, configure, script, and write code to solve customer needs: workflow setup, rule-building, field configuration, user and role management, reporting, data corrections, integrations, and small platform changes. - Translate complex Employee Health requirements (OSHA compliance, state-specific immunization mandates, system credentialing workflows, and the like) into solutions that actually work for our clients, in the Immuware platform. - Question their requirements and requests: Serving as the techncial expert, professionally challenge requests that don't serve the customer's real goal, and choose the simplest solution that solves the underlying problem to improve efficiency operationally. - Thoroughly document your solution designs in Notion, while updating live items in Jira, to ensure they are clear, well-scoped bug reports and feature requests that are repeatable and transferable to enable engineering efficiency. - Generalize your work: Turn one-off fixes into reusable templates, decision trees, or product improvements so the next customer benefits. - Triage net-new module or record-type additions that need a formal Letter of Work (LOW) and/or an ARR change (expansion) to CSMs and Professional Services. Customer Partnership - Serve as the technical counterpart to CSMs on customer calls: CSMs handle the relationship; you independently handle "how do we make it work." - Navigate internal client change: working alongside the CSMs, lead deeper, in-depth customer education beyond basic platform navigation, run workflow specific walkthroughs, and re-train as staff turnover and organizational change creates knowledge gaps. - Serve as the technical expert: build trusted-advisor relationships with power users and technical contacts at customer organizations. - Proactively identify configuration gaps or risks before they turn into escalations, and execute solutions to maintain the strong client relationship - Detail Oriented: Stay aware of each assigned customer's various environment, history, and upcoming needs. - Confidently identify and navigate between "I can fix this," "this needs a support ticket," and "this needs a product change." You'll Thrive in This Role If You - Are energized by customer calls and like solving problems live, not async. - Can read a healthcare compliance requirement and immediately start thinking about how to model and build it in a SaaS platform. - Have a builder's mindset: you're systematic, you test your own work, you write code when it's the right tool, and you don't leave a solution half-done. - Can switch comfortably between explaining something to an IT admin, a head nurse, a customer executive, and your own engineering team. - Are naturally organized. You manage several customers with different environments and needs at once. - Get frustrated by workarounds and push internally for real solutions. We'd Like It If You Had: - 5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role(solutions engineer, implementation consultant, technical account manager, or forward deployed engineer) - handling client resolutions, both live (virtually) and post meeting action items, and know how to navigate delays while staying calm under pressure and maintaining the clients trust. - 4-5 years navigating Azure, JavaScript, and Typescript with a strong background in SQL and Azure SQL database management. - 2-3+ experience operating in Notion and Jira - Proficiency in C#, and comfort reading a codebase, debugging, and writing scripts or small features, and track record of building on SaaS platforms, not just toggling settings: creating non-trivial workflows, rules, forms, reports, integrations, or role and permission structures. - Drive and ownership: You are comfortable and familiar with identifying the crux of large, enterprise customers' problems and outline additional potential issues as well. Then you own the solution outcome, driving these problems to resolution on your own instead of handing them off. - Strong written and verbal communication: You're credible with a customer's executives and technical staff and with internal product and engineering teams, and comfortable leading technical working sessions with non-technical stakeholders. - You handle delays, bugs, and scope pushback while keeping the customer's trust. - Structured problem-solving: You have experience scoping an issue for large, enterprise clients, find the root cause, and propose a solution in a live setting and navigate how to implement these solutions to our smaller accounts. - Comfort working without a playbook: you'll hit novel problems regularly and need to adapt as policies and regulations change. - Written reporting experience: familiarity writing clear, well-scoped bug reports and feature requests that engineering teams can act on. Preferred Qualifications: - Experience in healthcare IT, Employee Health, or occupational health. - Familiarity with immunization tracking, credentialing workflows, or OSHA and state health reporting requirements. - Familiarity with APIs and integrations, plus comfort with SQL or scripting for data investigation and fixes. - Prior use of Immuware or similar platforms (Tyto Care, Equifax I-9, or Symplr) What This Role Is Not: - Not account ownership. CSMs own renewals, expansion, and the executive relationship. The FDE supports those relationships through technical excellence. - Not billable Professional Services. PS handles formal implementation projects with SOWs. The FDE handles ongoing, post-go-live technical needs as part of the customer's subscription. - Not the L1/L2 support queue. The support team owns routine bug triage. This FDE will do deeper scoping and fixes, ensuring a clean handoff. It does not replace the support workflow. What Success Looks Like: 30 days: Support an active deal Within the first month, you will have built context on the healthcare customers motion, platform capabilities, common implementation needs, and regulated data considerations. They are supporting an active customer engagement with guidance. 60 days: Lead a solo engagement After two months, you are now independently leading a scoped customer sync, having built trust with customers technical teams, and delivering against customer requirements and timelines. 90 days: Own multiple, concurrent engagements At three months in, you are now independently managing multiple healthcare customer engagements, contributing reusable playbooks and tooling, and surfacing product feedback that helps convert bespoke implementation patterns into scalable capabilities. If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in healthcare and are focused on hiring individuals with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to support us in doing good, what’s human, and making a difference. Benefits and Perks for Propelus Employees US Employees: - Health Insurance: We cover up to 100% of the premium for employee medical insurance. Plans for spouses and children are made affordable through Propelus’ generous contribution - Employees can choose from HSA, FSA, and traditional insurance options for medical, dental, and vision coverage for themselves and dependents. - Dental and Vision plans, both including an option with 100% of the premium covered for employees - Generous PTO: - Accrual: (full-time US): 0–4 yrs 20 days | 5–9 yrs 25 days. | 10+ yrs 30 days per year (accrues quarterly: Jan 1, Apr 1, Jul 1, Oct 1; and is available immediately). - US-based teams observe 14 paid holidays each year - Floating Holiday: One floating holiday is yours to request on any day of your choice. This is separate from your PTO. - Birthday Holiday: Your birthday deserves celebrating! You get 1 paid day off during your birth month, separate from your PTO. - Volunteer Time Off: 16 hours available to you, that allow you to make an impact on causes that are meaningful to you. - Additional leave options: to support you in embracing life centricity - State & local leave laws - Where state or local leave laws provide additional protections, Propelus will comply with whichever regulation is more favorable to the employee. - 401K with company matching, as well as financial planning education and resources. - Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA): We support personal well-being by offering an annual lifestyle spending account that you can use for what matters most to you—whether it’s a gym membership, a meditation app, WFH equipment, or fresh produce delivered to your door. Think of it as a bonus for the expenses and experiences you value most. - Employee Assistance Programs: provides 24/7/365 support by phone and online — family clinical counseling, legal & financial services, plus child and elder care referrals. - Carrot Fertility & Hormonal Support: Inclusive hormonal health, fertility, and family-building benefits with funds toward eligible care. - Beyond Med: A licensed discount plan organization (DPO) giving you access to elective care like acupuncture, dermatology, fertility, GLP-1, and more — at discounted rates. - Spot Pet Insurance: A financial safety net for your furry family. Get reimbursed for emergencies, lab fees, behavior, x-rays, surgeries, cancer, and more. LATAM (Costa Rica and Colombia) Employees: - Your health is our top priority! We cover 100% of employee health insurance premiums. Our plans include national and international coverage, so you're protected no matter where you are. - Propelus Flex Club: Our flexible benefits platform gives you monthly points to redeem on what you need most. Plus, you'll get access to exclusive discounts just for being part of our team. (Details are country specific) - Generous PTO: - National Holidays (Colombia): 18 days - National Holidays (Costa Rica): 12 days - Birthday Holiday: Your birthday deserves celebrating! You get 1 paid day off during your birth month, separate from your PTO. - Volunteer Time Off: 16 hours available to you, that allow you to make an impact on causes that are meaningful to you. - We've got you covered with a life insurance policy, paid 100% by the company. You can also add your beneficiaries at an exclusive, discounted rate. - Carrot Fertility & Hormonal Support: Inclusive hormonal health, fertility, and family-building benefits with funds toward eligible care. Benefits and Perks for ALL Propelus employees include but are not limited to: A remote first company, global and distributed, with two office locations for those nearby who want a change of scenery. - A remote first company, global and distributed, with two US office locations for those nearby who want a change of scenery, and one in CO and CR. - Employees celebrating their 10 and 20 year work anniversary are eligible to take a trip sponsored by Propelus within one year of their 10th and 20th anniversary date. - Awarded one of BuiltIn's 2025 Best Places to Work and honored as a Silver Stevie® Award Winner in the 2025 Stevie Awards For Great Employers. - Professional development allowance to help you grow in the ways that mean the most to you. - Check us out for yourself at our careers page or our Propelus culture Instagram accounts. Typical Interview Process: - Interview #1: Brief intro screen with our People Ops team - Interview #2: Introduction with the Hiring Manager - Interview #3: Team Panel - Interview #4: Alignment interview with Senior Leadership If you don’t move forward to the next round, we’ll make sure you know as soon as possible. Tips for applicants: Focus on your application. At Propelus, everyone has an equal opportunity based on their merit. Reaching out to the team or providing referrals will not change your chances. We work remotely and communicate asynchronously, so writing is a key skill at Propelus. Please answer the application questions with your own thoughtful responses. Replies like "See resume" or N/A won't lead to an interview. Have some fun with it, we actually read these! We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Propelus. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Candidates from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. Full-time positions are scheduled to work 40 hours per week, M-F unless required otherwise by projects. Part-time positions are scheduled to work a maximum of 30 hours per week. Equipment, benefits, and perks are not provided to part-time or temporary employees. Compensation Range: $120K - $140K

data.title: Technical Lead
data.description:
About Us_ // At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel. Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit. Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what. The Role_ // As part of the Passenger Apps team, you'll lead the delivery and ongoing development of Masabi's native passenger applications, the white-label Justride/Passenger experience deployed across transit agencies worldwide, spanning iOS, Android and Web. This is a hands-on Technical Lead role with a balance of approximately 50% technical contribution and 50% people leadership, delivery management and team coordination of 4-6 developers. Alongside supporting a team of engineers, you'll remain actively involved in technical design, implementation, code reviews and delivery planning, focused on integrating Masabi's Justride SDK and public API platform capabilities. Location_ // This role is available in a remote model for candidates based in Poland Type of Role_ // This role is available as an up to 12 months Fixed Term Contract Responsibilities_ Technical Leadership & Delivery - Own delivery across the Passenger iOS, Android and Web applications, clearing blockers and keeping releases predictable - Remain actively involved in technical implementation, design discussions and code reviews, setting the bar for engineering quality - Drive the integration of Masabi's Justride SDK and public APIs into Passenger applications - Lead application migrations, release management, rollout planning and deployment activities - Support engineering practices that enable effective delivery across the team People Leadership & Team Development - Lead and support a team of engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, performance feedback and clear development conversations - Create an environment where engineers can grow, develop and do their best work - Partner closely with Product and Engineering stakeholders to align priorities, delivery plans and team goals - Foster a collaborative and inclusive team culture - Contribute to hiring, onboarding and team growth activities as needed - Provide visibility on delivery progress, risks and dependencies to stakeholders About You_ - Strong hands-on engineer at heart, current in at least one native platform (Swift/UIKit or Kotlin/Coroutines) and able to move confidently across both - You’ve led technical delivery across engineering teams, owning quality through code review and design guidance rather than stepping back from the work - You've managed and grown engineers directly, running 1:1s, coaching and honest feedback - Comfortable in multi-tenant or white-label products, where one codebase serves many customers with different needs - Experience delivering and evolving production applications, including migrations or modernisation efforts - Knowledgeable and experienced in SDK and API integrations - Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools and able to demonstrate how you’ve incorporated them into engineering workflow - A calm communicator who keeps stakeholders aligned and can hold the balance between coding and leading Nice to Have_ - Familiarity with release management, rollout strategies and deployment processes - Knowledge of CI/CD tooling and engineering quality practices - Participation in hiring, onboarding or team growth initiatives - Prior experience in Fintech or Transit domains Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all. // We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work. Whoever you are, just be yourself. // We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions. Why Join Masabi? - Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are. - Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey. - Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load. We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/technical-lead-masabi-jobs

data.title: Backend Engineer
data.description:
About the Role This is a backend engineering role at the heart of a fintech team building compliance and identity infrastructure for businesses. You will design scalable, high-trust systems and help shape the engineering culture of a senior, distributed team solving a genuinely hard technical problem. What You'll Do - Design and build backend systems that are clean, testable, and efficient. - Architect scalable APIs and infrastructure suited to high-trust, regulated environments. - Bring strong opinions on testing, quality, and long-term maintainability to every project. - Tackle complex product challenges by thinking deeply about user needs and system behavior. - Shape engineering practices and technical culture through collaboration and hands-on leadership. What We're Looking For - 5 or more years of backend engineering experience building production APIs, distributed services, or backend systems; the team skews toward 7+ years. - Strong systems thinking: ability to see beyond individual features and reason about large-scale architectural problems. - Experience building in high-trust or regulated domains such as fintech, payments, or identity. - Hands-on experience with relational databases (Postgres or similar) in production. - Experience with message queues or event-driven architectures (RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar). - Experience deploying and managing applications in containerized or cloud environments (Kubernetes, AWS, or similar). - A track record of writing automated tests and maintaining testable codebases. - Familiarity with Node.js, TypeScript, Express, and Event Sourcing patterns is a plus but not required. - Background at a high-caliber fintech, payments, or high-growth technology company is a strong signal. - Clear communicator who enjoys breaking down complexity and collaborating closely with teammates. - Comfortable working with ambiguity and driven by curiosity, big ambitions, and kindness. Compensation & Benefits Base salary: EUR 116,000 to 146,000, applied consistently at each level with no individual salary negotiation. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Fully remote, open to candidates in European timezones. European timezone availability is a hard requirement. The team meets in person every six weeks for a company-wide gathering.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer
data.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. About Anago At Anago, more than 55 colleagues have been making a daily impact on society for over 25 years. Our software helps public organisations plan better, prioritise more effectively, and deploy capacity efficiently — enabling faster decisions, more effective use of resources, and better responses to societal challenges. Think: faster procedures for asylum seekers, improved preventive healthcare, and better allocation of education budgets. We have built a strong position in the Netherlands and are now actively expanding internationally, including into the United Kingdom. The coming years will be defined by scaling up, broadening our market presence, and further professionalising our commercial organisation. At Anago, we work on impact — combining smart working with a warm, collaborative culture. The Role We are already taking concrete steps to integrate AI applications into our products. As Senior AI Engineer you have end responsibility for designing, setting up and further developing Anago's AI platform. As a front-runner you hold a strategic vision on AI adoption within the organisation and you put the AI structure in place. You build the foundation on which future AI, ML and LLM solutions within our organisation are developed, rolled out and managed. Because our software is used every day by public sector organisations, you steer on security, governance, continuity, cost efficiency and explainability. After all, AI functionality that supports decisions about people must be transparent, auditable and reliable. That is also your default way of building. You help give direction to how AI is applied within Anago, showing technical leadership and taking the lead on further AI adoption within Anago and towards our customers. This is emphatically not a research role; you spend most of your time designing, building, rolling out and managing AI systems that are used in production every day. Qualifications for Success - University (WO) level of education and thinking - At least 7 years of experience in software engineering, of which at least 3 years with AI, ML or LLM solutions in production environments - You live within a distance that makes being in the office in Den Bosch at least 50% of the time practical and sustainable over the long term - Demonstrable experience designing, building and managing business-critical AI platforms or AI solutions at scale - Experience with ML frameworks and MLOps tooling - Experience with LLMOps tooling such as LangFuse, LangSmith, LangChain or similar - Hands-on experience with cloud-native infrastructure and deployment, preferably Azure - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and pipeline orchestration (e.g. Airflow) - Strong programming skills (for example in Python) and experience with production environments - Solid knowledge of software architecture, data structures, algorithms, API design and distributed systems - A strong software engineering foundation with attention to testability, maintainability and code quality - Experience with code reviews, automated testing, version control and modern software development processes - Strong communication skills in English and Dutch (minimum B1) - You take ownership of the solutions you build and feel responsible for the result in production - You are able to translate technical complexity into practical solutions and clear choices What can you expect from us? You will work in an organisation where substance, collaboration and long-term impact come first. We strongly believe in the possibilities of AI and are actively building an AI-first approach within our products and our organisation. - A key role in the development of our AI platform - A great deal of freedom and responsibility - Direct impact on product, technology and organisation - Working on AI solutions with social relevance - Working in an ambitious and technically strong team - Room for development, experimentation and innovation - A fixed base salary between €5,291.59 and €7,559.41, depending on experience, knowledge and skills - Net phone and internet allowance - 8% holiday allowance - 26 holiday days, with the option to buy 6 extra days or 13 ADV (reduced working hours) days - Flexible working hours and the possibility to work hybrid; our office is located close to ’s-Hertogenbosch central station, where you can work flexible hours. In addition, the possibility to work from home with a fully equipped home workspace including a work-from-home allowance - A non-contributory pension - Top-up of paid parental and partner leave to 100% - A delicious catered lunch at the office every day (for a small contribution) - Regular team outings, drinks and activities, through which we regularly give something back to society Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Equal Employment Opportunity at Banyan: Banyan affirms that inequality is detrimental to our Global Teams, associates, our Operating Companies, and the communities we serve. As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance. Please Note: Banyan Software does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications submitted via email, LinkedIn, or other direct channels. All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. Applications submitted outside of our applicant tracking system will not be reviewed. Recruitment Notice Banyan Software may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation. Beware of Recruitment Scams We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. Protect yourself by following these steps: - Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address. - Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process. - If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it. Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

About the Role: Hims & Hers is on a mission to empower people to live healthier lives. Commerce is the engine that turns that mission into a seamless buying and subscription experience — the systems that power how customers discover products, see the right price, redeem promotions, pay, and check out across our platform. As we scale to serve millions of members, the reliability, flexibility, and intelligence of these systems directly shape revenue, conversion, and customer trust. As Director of Engineering for Commerce, you will be the single engineering DRI for the end-to-end commerce platform spanning catalog, pricing, promotions, payments, and checkout. You'll lead the teams and managers building the foundational systems that every customer transaction depends on, owning the technical vision, architecture, and delivery for a complex, high-throughput domain where correctness and uptime are non-negotiable. You'll partner closely with product, design, data, finance, Pharmacy, Care, and operations leaders to deliver a fast, trustworthy, conversion-optimized commerce experience, and you'll set the multi-year technical and organizational strategy that lets this platform scale. You Will: - Lead, coach, and inspire a team of engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. - Serve as the single engineering DRI for Commerce owning technical vision, strategy, and execution across catalog, pricing, promotions, payments, and checkout. - Drive the vision and execution of the next-generation commerce platform leading the shift to a rich, durable catalog domain model - Define and deliver the engineering roadmap in partnership with product and design — balancing innovation, reliability, scalability, and quality across the commerce domain. - Champion clear domain boundaries and enforced contracts — moving the organization off direct cross-domain database access and toward integration through APIs and published events. - Lead the team's transition to an AI-first engineering culture and spec-driven development - Scale architecture and systems with long-term growth and performance in mind, championing evolutionary architecture so the platform stays adaptable as the business and product surface area expand. - Oversee platform architecture for scalability, reliability, security, and compliance — with particular rigor for payments and financially sensitive transactions. - Drive alignment across squads and cross-functional partners to deliver key initiatives while managing competing priorities and trade-offs between speed, technical debt, and innovation. - Partner with data and analytics teams to make commerce smarter — improving pricing, promotion, and checkout experiences that increase conversion and retention. - Mentor and develop engineering leaders, with a focus on succession planning, leadership growth, and building a strong technical bench. - Own staffing and organizational strategy — hiring, headcount planning, and structuring teams to match the evolving needs of the Commerce domain. - Represent engineering in cross-functional and executive-level forums, translating strategy, status, and trade-offs for senior stakeholders and influencing key business decisions. You Have: - 12+ years of experience in software engineering, with 5+ years leading multiple teams or organizations in high-growth environments. - Proven success leading cross-functional product engineering teams and owning end-to-end consumer experiences. - Experience in health tech, e-commerce, or subscription-based platforms preferred. - Strong technical background with understanding of modern web and service architectures (Node.js, GraphQL, React, TypeScript, AWS, Kubernetes). - Expertise in building scalable, secure, and compliant systems handling clinical or health-related data. - Experience integrating third-party data sources, APIs, and device platforms (labs, wearables, fulfillment). - Ability to define and execute technical roadmaps aligned with product vision and business outcomes. - Strong communication skills and executive presence — able to translate between technical and business stakeholders. - Demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing engineering talent. - Strategic thinker with a bias for action and passion for building user-centric, data-driven health experiences. Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights): - Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles - Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days - Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave - Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) - 401k benefits with employer matching contribution - Offsite team retreats We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. data.title: Software Engineer, Internal Audit (All Levels)
data.description:
About Us Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners—specifically in cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits. We build software for the people who enable trust between businesses. We're based in San Francisco, CA, and built remote-first. We're backed by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, and more. Over 50 of the top 100 accounting and consulting firms trust Fieldguide to power mission-critical work. We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide's team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. About the Role You'll join a genuine 0→1 team on the ground floor of one of the company's biggest new bets. You will work full-stack on long-horizon agents, ship features that do real audit work, and work alongside practitioners. Depending on your experience and what you're looking to own, you may join building within a major agent area, owning one end-to-end, or setting technical direction for agentic audit work across the team. We're hiring across all levels and will calibrate during interviews based on scope and demonstrated experience. What You'll Do - Design and build agent-driven experiences for SOX control testing, deciding where autonomy makes sense and where the auditor stays in the loop - Own complex, end-to-end workstreams across the full stack - Make long agentic runs trustworthy: improve reliability, repeatability, performance, and observability so the same evidence produces the same defensible conclusion every time - Turn agent output into finished audit deliverables, including structured workpapers that adapt to whatever template a firm brings - Ship code from day one and ramp quickly into full ownership of significant product areas - Collaborate daily with product managers, designers, and SOX subject matter experts to work through difficult domain problems - Help shape technical direction and contribute to how the team thinks about agentic systems, AI tooling, and engineering best practices Who You Are (All Levels) - A strong full-stack engineer who writes code every day and wants to continue doing so - You've built with LLMs in production, not just in prototypes. You know what breaks when real users and real documents hit an agent - Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you figure things out as you go - Energized by 0→1 work: you'd rather define the problem than inherit a spec - High degree of ownership; you don't wait to be told what to do - A genuine team player across the organization, not just within engineering. You'll work directly with PM, design, domain experts, and customer-facing teams, and you treat that as the best part of the job - Able to pick up complex domain concepts quickly. You don't need to know SOX or internal controls, but you're the kind of person who can internalize it fast - Already using AI coding tools in your workflow and curious about where agentic approaches create real leverage Higher-Level Responsibilities At the Senior level, you may: - Lead complex projects or systems, setting technical direction and ensuring long-term health - Collaborate with PMs and designers to shape roadmaps and define architectural tradeoffs - Serve as a domain expert within one or more technical areas (e.g., agent orchestration, evaluation and quality, document processing, frontend architecture) - Mentor other engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team At the Staff level, you may: - Drive company-level technical initiatives and influence cross-team architecture - Set and champion engineering standards for scalability, security, and performance - Partner with engineering and product leadership to define long-term technical strategy - Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across Engineering, Product, and Design - Represent Fieldguide externally through writing, speaking, and open-source contributions Experience Must-have: - Shipped LLM-backed product features to production against real users - Comfortable full-stack, with enough backend depth to work in agent orchestration - Autonomy working from an ambiguous spec - A collaborative mindset with an ability to work across PM, design, and domain experts - Willingness to develop an Applied AI skillset including writing evals, using LLM observability tools, and being thoughtful about quality Nice-to-have: - Startup experience, as a founder or as an early engineer - A track record of 0→1 projects you took from nothing to something people use - Experience working directly with customers, and comfort being in the room when they use what you built - Experience in internal audit, SOX, financial services, accounting, or compliance - Familiarity with our stack: TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, and Temporal - Experience with document processing, PDF/Excel manipulation, or evaluation frameworks for model output Not a fit if: - You’re not interested in deeply learning about Agents - You’ve never built a product to scale - You need a fully specified ticket to start - You'd rather not be in the room with customers and domain experts What Should Excite You - 0→1 on the biggest bet: You're building the agent and the product from scratch, on the ground floor of where the company is going - Real audit stakes: Your work directly affects what firms put in front of their clients, and what a reviewer is willing to sign - Customer proximity: Design-partner firms and an embedded SOX expert use what you ship within days of it landing - High trust, high autonomy: You're given ambiguous problems and trusted to define the plan Benefits - Competitive compensation with equity - Comprehensive health and wellness benefits - Flexible time off and work schedules - Technology reimbursements - 401(k) plan - Twice-yearly in-person offsites across the U.S. - Wellness benefits starting on your first day Our Values - Fearless — Inspire and break down seemingly impossible walls - Fast — Launch fast with excellence; iterate to perfection - Lovable — Deliver happiness and 11-star experiences - Owners — Execute and run the business with ownership - Win-win — Create mutual value and earn trust for life - Inclusive — Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams

data.title: Creative eLearning Developer
data.description:
Who is Tenable? Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! What makes Tenable such a great place to work? Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc Your Role: The Creative eLearning Developer designs and builds interactive training services, offering collateral and enablement content for the Services Portfolio by combining three capabilities in one role: multimedia/video design, graphic design, and technical writing. This role turns technical subject matter into polished, field-ready courses, videos, and collateral for websites, presentations, classrooms, and e-learning platforms - owning a deliverable from storyboard through final published, LMS-ready package. This is a “creative” eLearning Developer specifically: unlike a standard eLearning Developer who authors courses from assets supplied by others, this role also creates the graphic and multimedia assets themselves - 2-D/3-D graphics, video animation, and course visuals, in addition to authoring interactive modules in tools like Articulate Storyline or Rise 360 and writing the scripts, captions, and course copy that tie a deliverable together. The role also manages one or more supporting processes for the team (e.g., video mastering, templates, or SCORM packaging standards), working largely self-directed with minimal supervision and reporting status to leadership at regular intervals. Your Opportunity: Multimedia & Video Design: - Video & Audio Editing: Edit video and audio into the final training, services and marketing deliverables. - Storyboard Translation: Translate storyboards into technical infographics and animated sequences. - 3-D & Motion Assets: Create line art, 2-D graphics, 3-D imaging, and video animation for course and presentation content. Graphic Design & Brand Hub: - Template & Style Systems: Create, maintain, and utilize templates for presentations, documents, and animations using a variety of development tools. - Brand & Style Guides: Contribute to creating style guides for deliverables, ensuring visual and written consistency across the portfolio. - Visual Layout: Design presentation layouts and visual assets that translate technical information into a clear visual story. - Brand Evolution Support: Support the Senior Manager, Services Portfolio Production, in executing the corporate “house style” overhaul across all One Tenable, Prime assets, including the Tier 1/2 rebrand timeline. - Creative Request Hub: Act as a direct creative design point of contact for the Senior Director and leadership — turning around presentations, graphics, and one-off collateral on request — with strict adherence to brand guidelines. - Brand Guideline Stewardship: Maintain and enforce brand standards (logo usage, typography, color, iconography) across all portfolio deliverables, and flag or correct off-brand assets in circulation. Technical Writing & Content Development: - Script & Course Copy: Write and edit scripts, voiceover text, captions, and on-screen callouts, maintaining a consistent voice across written and visual content. - Documentation: Maintain technical and course documentation to support the assets you build. - Content Evaluation: Evaluate existing visual and written content and recommend improvements for clarity and engagement. eLearning Authoring & Publishing: - Course Authoring: Build interactive learning modules — branching scenarios, quizzes, and simulations — using tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, or Adobe Captivate. - Packaging & LMS Publishing: Package courses to SCORM/xAPI standards, publish to the LMS, and test for compatibility and learner tracking. - Accessibility: Apply accessibility standards (e.g., Section 508) to eLearning content. Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery: - Requirements Gathering: Meet with stakeholders to gather requirements and develop design plans. - Iterative Feedback: Perform edits based on feedback from Solution Architects, peers, and leadership. - Deadline Management: Create deliverables within time constraints to meet project deadlines. - Independent Execution: Perform tasks with minimal supervision, managing one or more supporting processes (e.g., video mastering, templates, SCORM packaging standards) end-to-end. Team Leadership & Mentorship: - Mentorship: Mentor and develop less experienced designers, sharing craft and process knowledge across the production team. What You'll Need: - Minimum 5 years of eLearning development, multimedia, or graphic/video design experience in a professional setting. - Comfortable writing and maintaining technical/course documentation, scripts, and captions for course and video deliverables. - Familiarity with the full product delivery life cycle: requirements analysis, design, testing, implementation. - B.A./B.S. in graphic design, instructional design, educational technology, or a related field, or comparable experience. - Proficiency with Articulate Storyline and/or Rise 360 (or Adobe Captivate), plus Adobe Creative Cloud and Camtasia. - Strong presentation design skills (PowerPoint, Google Slides, or Keynote) for fast-turnaround, executive-ready decks in addition to core Adobe Creative Cloud work. - Experience building or maintaining a brand guideline system (logo, typography, color, iconography) at an organizational level. - Working knowledge of SCORM/xAPI packaging and LMS publishing; awareness of accessibility standards such as Section 508. - Working knowledge of Instructional Design frameworks (e.g., ADDIE). - Experience or knowledge of Tenable products; familiarity with network architecture and Tenable cybersecurity practices for enterprise environments. - Proficiency with Jira and Confluence. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - Strong initiative and the ability to work remotely, both self-directed and as part of a geographically distributed team. - This role may require the ability to work in a hybrid/on-site capacity at our headquarters in Columbia MD or Boston MA. This position is US-based only. - Ability to work remotely in a self-directed manner - Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods - Physically able to participate in training sessions, presentations and meetings - Some Tenable office travel may be required #LI-Hybrid #LI-MM1 This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. data.title: Director, Applied AI
data.description:
Headquarters: Bethesda, Maryland, United States; Remote-US-MA; Remote-US-MD; Remote-US-WA; Vancouver, Washington, United States; Waltham, Massachusetts, United States

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.

You'll lead the team that builds the intelligence every ZoomInfo AI agent reasons over — what's true about companies and the people in them, how they relate, and what they're buying. This role owns the B2B data graph strategy end to end, blending classical machine learning and data science with LLM and agentic systems, and treating evaluation and inference cost as core disciplines. You'll set the technical bar for a team of senior engineers while staying close to the code, shipping alongside the people you lead.

What You'll Do

  • You will ship code alongside your team, prototype alone to prove or kill an idea, and review code as a peer, setting how the team uses agentic coding tools with precise specifications and rigorous review.
  • You will own delivery end-to-end, from problem framing through serving and on-call, including long-tail graph coverage and user memory for agents that separates user-supplied context from system-of-record data.
  • You will choose the right method for each problem — classical machine learning, language models, or code — for challenges like sparse-company revenue estimation, entity resolution, and semantic intent modeling, deciding on measured evidence and stopping work that won't pay off.
  • You will define what it takes to claim an agent's output is correct, not just that its run completed, building the evaluation datasets, regression gates, and experiment designs that back those claims.
  • You will own inference cost, latency, and capacity, including build-versus-buy and distillation decisions, since a model too expensive to run everywhere isn't a result.
  • You will hire and grow machine learning engineers, data scientists, and research engineers, developing senior engineers into technical leaders.
  • You will work across product, platform, security, and legal, and present results and their limits to executives, including when a system isn't good enough to launch.

What You Bring

Must-Have:

  • You have significant experience building production machine learning systems and leading the engineers who build them by shipping alongside them — demonstrated capability matters more than years.
  • You have a track record of hiring and developing senior machine learning engineers and data scientists against a high bar.
  • You stay hands-on today: shipping code, building prototypes independently, and using agentic coding tools daily with rigorous review.
  • You bring deep classical machine learning and data science expertise (supervised learning, feature engineering, statistical inference and experiment design, strong SQL) alongside production LLM and agentic systems, with the judgment to choose between them, including setting an evaluation bar with leakage-safe validation, calibration, and validated LLM judges.
  • You have a record of cost and capacity decisions for model serving, such as moving a workload from a hosted model to a distilled or self-hosted one, with the savings measured, and you report results to executives with their limits stated, including recommending against a launch.

Preferred:

  • You bring entrepreneurial experience — founding a company, or taking a product from inception to paying customers as a founding or early engineer.
  • You have experience in propensity modeling, ranking and retrieval, clustering, or entity resolution at scale.
  • You have worked on web-scale language processing over multilingual, noisy text, knowledge graphs, or user memory for agents.
  • You have experience with post-training and distillation, open-weight model serving, or AI governance and safety practices (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF).

data.title: Horizon: Full-Stack Engineer (Senior)
data.description:
We’re seeking a skilled Full-Stack Engineer to build the next-generation data management and artificial intelligence platform for maritime domain awareness. Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure. Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success. What you’ll do We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include: - Build out application components and pages. - Implement historical and real-time data feeds using WebGPU. - Design and develop data models using Postgres and Apache Iceberg. - Modify real-time data pipelines using MQTT and Redpanda. - Modify offline data pipelines using Dagster for batch processing. - Modify and integrate machine learning models or other algorithms into the application. - Improve local development and CI/CD using modern tooling and GitHub Actions. Who you are We’re looking for someone with strong Full-Stack Engineering skills who shares our most important values: - You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has 100% test coverage. - You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that downstream consumers trust libraries and services you build. - You obsess over performance. You daydream about Lighthouse scores and query speed. - You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You’re always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding. - You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop. - You’re a great teacher. You know how to break down a concept for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited. Why work with us - We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished. - Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture. - We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values. - We’re remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub. - We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success. - We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here. - We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads. Important skills - Expertise in TypeScript. - Expertise in CSS, such as TailwindCSS. - Experience with React and frontend frameworks such as Next.js. - Familiar with state management such as React Context. - Experience with Node.js, GraphQL, and REST APIs. - Proficiency with SQL/PostgreSQL. - Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. - Knowledge of Python. Nice to have - Experience with IoT devices and sensors. - Digital signal processing experience. - Geospatial analysis and GIS experience. - Familiar with working in monorepos. What we offer - Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance. - Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first. - Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected. - 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones. - Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career. - Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter. - Mission-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact. - Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future. Additional benefit opportunities when you choose Spear AI: - 401(k) with company match. - Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent). - Relocation assistance (position dependent). - Referral bonuses. - Performance bonuses. - Life insurance and disability coverage. - Technology home office setup stipend. - Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent). We offer competitive compensation tailored to your experience, location, and the impact you’ll make. We’re committed to equitable pay and will share a range aligned to your level and geography during the hiring process. In accordance with state law, candidates in jurisdictions such as CA, CO, WA, NY, and others, where applicable, will be provided a good-faith salary range upon request and throughout the hiring process. This is a full-time, exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay. Compensation for this position is provided on a salaried basis and is not subject to reduction based on hours worked. At Spear AI, you’ll find more than just a job; you’ll join a mission-driven team where your work directly contributes to national security. Our flat organizational structure means your voice matters, your ideas reach leadership, and your impact is visible. As we grow, we’re committed to building robust processes and infrastructure that support both our mission and our people. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and the expertise each team member brings to the table. If you’re looking for a place to grow professionally while working on projects that truly matter, we’d love to hear from you.

data.title: Meridian: Full-Stack Engineer (Mid-level)
data.description:
We’re seeking a skilled Full-Stack Engineer to build the next-generation data management and artificial intelligence platform for maritime domain awareness. Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure. Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success. What you’ll do We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include: - Build out application components and pages. - Implement historical and real-time data feeds using WebGPU. - Design and develop data models using Postgres and Apache Iceberg. - Modify real-time data pipelines using MQTT and Redpanda. - Modify offline data pipelines using Dagster for batch processing. - Modify and integrate machine learning models or other algorithms into the application. - Improve local development and CI/CD using modern tooling and GitHub Actions. Who you are We’re looking for someone with strong Full-Stack Engineering skills who shares our most important values: - You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has 100% test coverage. - You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that downstream consumers trust libraries and services you build. - You obsess over performance. You daydream about Lighthouse scores and query speed. - You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You’re always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding. - You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop. - You’re a great teacher. You know how to break down a concept for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited. Why work with us - We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished. - Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture. - We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values. - We’re remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub. - We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success. - We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here. - We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads. Important skills - Expertise in TypeScript. - Expertise in CSS, such as TailwindCSS. - Experience with React and frontend frameworks such as Next.js. - Familiar with state management such as React Context. - Experience with Node.js, GraphQL, and REST APIs. - Proficiency with SQL/PostgreSQL. - Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. - Knowledge of Python. Nice to have - Experience with IoT devices and sensors. - Digital signal processing experience. - Geospatial analysis and GIS experience. - Familiar with working in monorepos. What we offer - Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance. - Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first. - Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected. - 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones. - Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career. - Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter. - Mission-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact. - Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future. Additional benefit opportunities when you choose Spear AI: - 401(k) with company match. - Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent). - Relocation assistance (position dependent). - Referral bonuses. - Performance bonuses. - Life insurance and disability coverage. - Technology home office setup stipend. - Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent). We offer competitive compensation tailored to your experience, location, and the impact you’ll make. We’re committed to equitable pay and will share a range aligned to your level and geography during the hiring process. In accordance with state law, candidates in jurisdictions such as CA, CO, WA, NY, and others, where applicable, will be provided a good-faith salary range upon request and throughout the hiring process. This is a full-time, exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay. Compensation for this position is provided on a salaried basis and is not subject to reduction based on hours worked. At Spear AI, you’ll find more than just a job; you’ll join a mission-driven team where your work directly contributes to national security. Our flat organizational structure means your voice matters, your ideas reach leadership, and your impact is visible. As we grow, we’re committed to building robust processes and infrastructure that support both our mission and our people. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and the expertise each team member brings to the table. If you’re looking for a place to grow professionally while working on projects that truly matter, we’d love to hear from you.

Framer Website Designer (Onsite – Presidio, San Francisco)

About Air Apps

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018 and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco, we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.

Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.

Join us on this journey to redefine resource management and change lives along the way.

  • This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.

The Role

As a Framer Website Designer, you’ll take ownership of designing and building high-performing, visually compelling websites using Framer. You’ll collaborate closely with our marketing, product, and engineering teams to create seamless web experiences that reflect our brand vision while meeting business and performance goals.

You’ll also work directly with SEO professionals, your closest collaborators, to ensure all pages are optimized for discoverability, loading speed, and accessibility. From landing pages to product microsites, your designs will directly influence how millions of users engage with Air Apps online.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build responsive, accessible, and engaging websites and landing pages using Framer.

  • Partner with SEO experts to ensure designs meet performance, accessibility, and search engine optimization standards.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders from brand, marketing, and product to align on business goals and messaging.

  • Develop modular components and templates for scalable site structures.

  • Maintain and evolve the visual identity of our web presence in line with Air Apps’ brand guidelines.

  • Monitor site analytics and user behavior to inform iterative improvements and A/B testing.

  • Stay up to date with web design trends, Framer updates, and best practices in site performance.

Requirements

  • Around 3–5+ years of experience designing and building websites with a strong emphasis on visual storytelling and UX.

  • Deep proficiency in Framer, with a strong portfolio of responsive web experiences or live projects.

  • Solid understanding of web design principles including layout, hierarchy, typography, and mobile-first design.

  • Familiarity with web performance best practices, SEO fundamentals, and accessibility standards (WCAG).

  • Ability to work collaboratively with SEO and marketing teams to align design with search and content strategies.

  • Experience maintaining or contributing to a design system.

  • Strong visual communication and prototyping skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience working on marketing sites for SaaS, tech, or AI-driven products.

  • Familiarity with HTML/CSS or understanding of how websites are developed under the hood.

What benefits do we offer?

  • Apple hardware ecosystem for work.

  • Annual Bonus

  • Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.

  • Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.

  • Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.

  • Childcare support.

  • Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.

  • Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.

  • Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.

  • Meals 100% free at the hub.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.

Application Disclaimer

At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

data.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. We launched a new ad-supported tierin November 2022 to offer our members more choice in how they consume their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. Our Team The Ads Serving Platform engineering team sits within the Ad Serving & Decisioning org at Netflix Ads. We own the high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems that power real-time ad decisioning. Our work focuses on the core platform architectures supporting ranking and scoring, auction mechanics, budget and pacing systems, and goal-based delivery optimization. We care deeply about how systems work and building resilient systems at scale. We are looking for a senior technical leader to own the technical direction of this platform pod, set the architectural bar, and drive execution on the hardest problems in high-throughput systems optimization at Netflix. What You'll Do - Technical Direction:Help drive the overall technical direction of the ad-serving platform. Partner across engineering teams to ensure the ecosystem meets SLAs, SLOs, and uptime requirements. - Low-Latency Distributed Platform:Architect a concurrent platform optimized for high-throughput systems while monitoring, diagnosing, and mitigating tail latencies across core execution paths. - Networking & Performance Engineering:Work with I/O-bound and CPU-bound workloads. Profile and tune network and system layers, and build automated performance-benchmarking frameworks within the CI/CD pipeline to identify latency regressions. - Modular Platform Design:Build a modular architecture that enables other teams to build on top of the platform. Create entry points for external components like model-serving runtimes, budget/pacing systems, and programmatic demand engines that handle outbound networking and QPS management. - Operational Excellence & Resiliency:Architect a system that is straightforward to operate and maintain. Maintain a high standard for distributed systems design and resiliency, ensuring graceful degradation during traffic spikes or live events. Skills & Experience We're Seeking - Distributed Systems Experience:10+ years of experience building distributed systems, core backend infrastructure, or high-throughput platforms. - Low-Latency Systems Engineering:Deep expertise writing clean, highly optimized code in systems languages (e.g., Java, Go, C++, or Rust) with a proven track record of handling high-transaction volumes. - Concurrency & Algorithmic Design:Practical experience with multi-threaded systems design, concurrent programming, and algorithmic design for highly concurrent workloads (including lock-free data structures or lock contention mitigation). - Networking & I/O Optimization:Understanding of distributed system fundamentals, specifically managing I/O-bound and CPU-bound workloads, network protocols, and data partitioning strategies. - Performance Measurement & Telemetry:Experience using profiling and diagnostic tools to measure system performance, analyze tail latencies, identify execution hotspots, and build telemetry or monitoring hooks. - Architecture & Collaboration:Ability to translate complex algorithmic requirements (such as business logic or data science models) into extensible platform components that support multiple teams. - Modern Development Tooling:Comfort using modern development tools and LLM assistance to accelerate implementation while maintaining architectural oversight and code quality.
